subject: Invoice intake conventions & email backstop plan for LumenSupply
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: LumenSupply Billing <billing@lumensupply.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice intake conventions & next steps (portal vs email)

Hi Carlos / LumenSupply billing team,

Thanks for signing the vendor agreement last week — welcome aboard. We’re starting your billing intake onboarding and want to pick the simplest path to get you paid reliably. Two quick options:

1) Portal (preferred): upload invoices to our supplier portal: secure, auto-ack, PO matching, faster payment runs.
2) Email backstop (acceptable): send invoices to billing@redwood.com with a strict subject/body convention and a single PDF attachment — we’ll ingest via SMTP fallback.

Before we set up your portal account, can you confirm whether you can:
- Receive an invitation to the portal (yes/no)
- If no, confirm you can send invoices by email with PDF attachments only (no ZIPs)

Attached is a compact CSV invoice template (invoice-template-compact.csv) showing minimal fields we need for line-item matching. If email is your only option, please use one of these subject-line formats so our ingest pipeline can route automatically:

- Invoice: LumenSupply / PO 12345 / INV-2026-037
- Redwood PO 67890 - Invoice INV-2026-037

Also include the PO number on the first line of the email body and as a header row on the PDF. For multi-PO invoices please split into separate PDFs where possible (our AP system prefers one PO per invoice).

Link to onboarding form: https://drive.redwood.internal/suppliers/LumenSupply/onboarding-form (please complete so we can provision portal or set up a stable email route).

If you can’t do portal or strict subject lines, we’ll accept email but will need a short SLA: invoices must be emailed to billing@redwood.com before 12pm PT on payment cutoff days and include a single PDF attachment named INV-<number>.pdf.

Next steps: reply with your preferred intake method and I’ll send either a portal invite or confirm email routing + sample subject/body.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: invoice-template-compact.csv (CSV with header row: invoice_number,invoice_date,po_number,supplier_name,amount_cents,currency,tax_amount_cents,line_description)

From: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@lumensupply.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice intake conventions & next steps (portal vs email)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear options. A couple of constraints on our side:

- We do not have an SSO-capable portal team right now and onboarding a new portal user will take 2–3 weeks.
- We can send invoices via email immediately.
- We sometimes have combined invoices that reference 2 PO numbers on the same PDF (our ERP exports that way).

Questions:
1) If we send one PDF with two PO lines, will Redwood split into two payments or does it need two PDFs?
2) Do we need to embed line-item CSV in the email body or is the PDF enough?
3) VAT: we operate in the UK and may include VAT lines — is that fine and which currency should we use for the subject line?

We can follow the subject-line convention you suggested. Example we would send:
Subject: Invoice: LumenSupply / PO 98765 / INV-2026-112

I’ll confirm with our billing ops about single vs multi-PO PDF and circle back.

Cheers,
Carlos
Head of Finance Operations
LumenSupply
carlos.vega@lumensupply.co
+44 20 7946 0958

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice intake conventions & next steps (portal vs email)

Marissa / Neha — quick proposed operational rules for email backstop (to keep ingestion reliable and minimize manual work):

1) Subject requirement (automated routing): one of:
   - "Invoice: <SupplierName> / PO <PO#> / <INV#>"
   - "Redwood PO <PO#> - Invoice <INV#>"
   - For non-PO invoices: "Invoice: <SupplierName> / Non-PO / <INV#>"

2) Attachment: single PDF only. If supplier can't split multi-PO PDFs, require a one-line header for each PO in the PDF and duplicate the PDF with a clear filename for each PO (preferred but optional).

3) Body: first line must include the PO(s) and invoice number (machine-readable): e.g., PO: 98765; INV: INV-2026-112

4) Currency/VAT: allow VAT lines and GL details in PDF. For multi-currency, include currency code in subject (USD/EUR/GBP). Example subject: "Invoice: LumenSupply / PO 98765 / INV-2026-112 / GBP"

5) Minimal acceptance criteria for automated ingest: subject format OK, single PDF attached, PO present in body header. If any of these fail, route to manual AP inbox with SLA 48 business hours.

Sample CSV row (attachment used for pilots) — header then a sample:
invoice_number,invoice_date,po_number,supplier_name,amount_cents,currency,tax_amount_cents,line_description
INV-2026-112,2026-06-01,98765,LumenSupply,1250000,GBP,250000,Cloud inference credits - June

I’m attaching the compact CSV template you can share as an optional mapping artifact. If LumenSupply needs portal mitigation, we can accept email for the first two billing cycles and revisit portal within 30 days.

Ben
Sr. Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0133

Attachment: invoice-template-compact.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@lumensupply.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice intake conventions & next steps (portal vs email)

Hi Carlos — thanks for the quick reply and context. Plan below: we will accept email-only intake for the initial onboarding with the following mandatory items so our automated pipeline can process payment without repeated manual intervention.

Mandatory for email intake (effective immediately):
- Send to: billing@redwood.com
- Subject: use one of the approved formats (examples below) and include currency code if not USD.
  * Invoice: LumenSupply / PO 98765 / INV-2026-112 / GBP
  * Redwood PO 98765 - Invoice INV-2026-112
- Attach exactly one PDF per email. If your ERP exports combined PO PDFs, please also include a separate copy of the PDF renamed per-PO (we’ll accept temporary duplicates for the first 2 cycles).
- First line of email body: PO: 98765; INV: INV-2026-112; CUR: GBP
- If VAT is present, include VAT amount on the PDF — currency code in subject determines currency.

We’ll set your supplier profile to "email-backstop" and mark a portal invite as low priority; we’ll reevaluate in 30 days. Please fill out the short onboarding form here: https://drive.redwood.internal/suppliers/LumenSupply/onboarding-form and attach the completed PDF to your first invoice email. That form helps us map your vendor tax and remittance fields.

If you want, Ben will run a one-off pilot ingestion this Friday — send one sample invoice (real or mock) and we’ll validate mapping and confirm payment timing.

Thanks — looking forward to smoother operations.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: supplier-onboarding-form.pdf
